classPassive.name: Alchemist Potion
descriptions:
Allows using Alchemical Utensils.        
        You gain 1 potion every 1.5s, up to        
        a maximum of 8 potions.        
                 
        Right Button to throw Brutal potions        
        that deal magic damage (⭐) in an area.        
                 
        Left Button to throw Gruesome potions        
        that deal 80% of regular damage, but         
        inflict 5% Slowness, 5% Vulnerability,        
        and 5% Weakness to mobs for 8s.
